item.title: Chatham hospital boiler breakdown speeds up plans to replace system
item.description: The breakdown of the boiler system at the Chatham hospital has sped up an infrastructure renewal plan by the Chatham-Kent Health Alliance. A temporary boiler is being installed and another is being sourced to get the hospital back up the full steam, health alliance president and chief executive Adam Topp said on a conference call […]

item.description: Sammy DiBlasi is back to his winning ways.

item.title: Council votes to keep PUC governance status quo
item.description: Chatham-Kent's Public Utilities Commission will stick with its current governance structure, at least until the next council term.

item.title: Art Under the Stars fetes art, culture, business in Chatham's core
item.description: Looking to beat the winter blahs? The community is invited to celebrate art, culture and local business in downtown Chatham Friday.

item.description: The two-year pilot effort aims to enhance community supports for people facing mental health and addiction challenges.
